detail.longDescription: Butterfly 2.6.2-rc.0 is here! This release comes a little earlier than expected, mainly because of an important security issue affecting Flutter applications. Highlights: 🔒 Important TLS security update 🪟 Experimental floating editor layout 🤝 More collaboration synchronization options 💾 Better backups and automatic thumbnails 📄 PDF and document search improvements 🛠️ Bug fixes and build improvements Read more here: https://www. linwood.dev/butterfly/2.6.2-rc .0/ # flutter # opensource # productivity
